name: fightbot-free
description: FightBot Free - UFC Discord Bot with essential fight information and interactive features

scripts.test: echo "FightBot Free - Run specific tests with npm run test:simple or npm run test:ufc"
scripts.test:simple: node -e "console.log('✅ FightBot Free v1.0.0 - Basic test passed!')"
scripts.test:ufc: node -e "import('./services/ufcService.js').then(m => new m.default().getUpcomingEvent().then(e => console.log('✅ UFC Service test:', e?.title || 'Connected')))"
